# hyperping_escalation_policies (Data Source)

Fetches the list of all Hyperping escalation policies via MCP.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) List of escalation policy UUIDs.
- `policies` (Attributes List) List of escalation policies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the policy.
- `name` (String) The name of the policy.
- `steps` (Attributes List) The escalation steps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies--steps))
- `team` (String) The team name this policy belongs to.

<a id="nestedatt--policies--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies.steps`

Read-Only:

- `delay` (Number) Delay in minutes before the step is triggered.
- `target_id` (String) The ID of the escalation target.
- `target_type` (String) The type of the escalation target (user, schedule, integration).
